markets.title: Will above 0 jobs be added in November 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If the increase in total non-farm payroll employment is above 0 as reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics Monthly Employment Situation Report for the month of November 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The market closes at 8:29 AM ET on the expected date of the data release.
